description: Set the plot's boundary from a polygon — for a plot outside Poland, one the land registry gets wrong, or the designer's measurements ("18 by 25 m"). Absolute vertices in metres, in the garden coordinates zones use (the garden's place is at 0,0; x east, y south when north is up), e.g. traced from the OpenStreetMap background in capture_preview. Replaces any boundary; the change is unsaved until save. A placed plot becomes located and the map refits around it. Returns {area (m²), plot: 'located' | 'unlocated'}.

polygon.description: The boundary's corners in order, at least 3, absolute metres

name: set_boundary
